verdicts.reason: I'd pick B. A breaks the reading order: the headline sits above the SOLSTICE wordmark, and the headline runs over the green decorative circle. A also leaves a large empty gap between the body copy and the can, so the product ends up stranded low on the canvas. B keeps the original order (wordmark, can, headline, body, CTA) with a clear hierarchy, but it still needs fixes: the green circle has shrunk to a meaningless sliver in the corner, there is uneven dead space above the CTA, and the small body copy wraps into four short lines.
